---
title: Manage Pop Up Banner
description: >-
  Monitor pop-up banner, track publishing statuses, and edit contents or delete
  outdated alerts to ensure a relevant user experience.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Pop Up Banner > Pop Up Banner List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="300" height="167" style="width: 300px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view pop up banner details, delete or duplicate pop up banner.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="725" height="248" style="width: 725px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify existing pop up banner image, title and details.

* Delete or copy pop up banner.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="395" height="294" style="width: 395px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
